verdict.rationale: Gladia's homepage claims "100% EU data residency", so it does document where data is stored. But the pack shows no user-facing way to pick a region or residency option, so this reads as a fixed EU guarantee rather than a choice. missing for 10: user-selectable region or residency configuration, documentation of how residency is set via API or account, any non-EU region options, independent corroboration of the residency claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: true multilingual support and 100% EU data residency
